title: Hand water pump
prompt: a cast-iron village hand water pump: lift and push the handle, water rises and pours from the spout, fill a bucket; see-through shows the piston, two check valves, rising main and the well below
blurb: Work the handle of a cast-iron village pump and watch a brass plunger, deep in the well, lift water up the rising main one half-litre stroke at a time until it pours into your bucket.
